F1: Init` is now called only from the constructor (server.go:258), so the "service is stopped" error that `Stop` stores in `initErr` no longer blocks any RPC.
F2: BuildIndex` now locks only around the cache write (bleve.go:137-139), and `getOrCreateIndex` has no per-key guard, so the same key can be built twice at once and the later build replaces the first without closing it.
F3: TotalDocs` loops over `b.cache` without the lock, and the new startup log call (search.go:216) runs after the event goroutine starts, so it can overlap a `BuildIndex` map write.
F4: the reviewer says this race on `err` and the counter is outside the hunk and predates the diff; the change did not touch that code.
